Shaggy, unkempt jet black hair with long, jagged bangs covering the upper face. Glowing pale yellow eyes with a narrow, menacing expression. Appears as a mature adult with a lean, agile build. Wears a dark charcoal grey hooded cloak and tattered black leather armor with deep crimson accents. Features a distinctive white cloth mask covering the lower face and a large, jagged obsidian-colored blade.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
